sentences.en: Trade friction might arise between the nations at any moment.
sentences.zh: 1. 贸易摩擦可能在任何时候在这两国之间产生。

sentences.en: Bribes are something that arises in conjunction with power organizations.
sentences.zh: 2. 贿赂与权力组织相伴而生。

sentences.en: What defines us is how well we arise after falling.
sentences.zh: 3. 定义我们的是我们在跌倒后重新站起来的能力。

senses.zh: 产生,出现,起身，起立,起源于，产生于
